why: Drops the slot context from the who's-playing role buttons, so four slots announce four identical runs of Human/Bot/Off and the only thing tying a control to its player is screen position -- the one cue a non-visual reader does not get. Note the replacement still SETS a name: an emptiness sweep and a bare-digit sweep both pass. It is caught only by the uniqueness rule, which is why that rule is written as 'no two of these share a name' rather than as a spot-check on one label.
